lede: UCLA carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.2 against +1.1, a 7.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Maryland -1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Maryland winning 50% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
